cards.title: Amazon Stops Using NDAs for Data Center Deals
cards.body: Amazon will cease using NDAs in local government data center negotiations, following Microsoft's earlier move this year. The shift addresses community backlash against AI infrastructure secrecy that has sparked hundreds of proposed restrictions.

cards.title: Google Launches Agentic AI for Gemini Business
cards.body: Google is transforming Gemini into an AI agent capable of planning, executing tasks, and integrating with business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, leverage multiple AI models, and operates with its own workplace identity including an email address.

cards.title: Anthropic Updates Claude Usage Policy
cards.body: Anthropic's new usage policy explicitly bans repeated model abuse and addresses election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance. Ordinary frustration and criticism remain permitted under the updated guidelines.

cards.title: Arena Leaderboard Raises $200M Series B
cards.body: The company behind LMArena has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, nearly doubling its valuation to $3.1 billion in 10 months. The platform now measures AI models on alignment issues including lying and deception.

cards.title: Google Releases Local-First Meeting Note App
cards.body: Google's new AI Edge Foresight app offers offline meeting transcription, note generation, and Q&A using on-device AI. The app competes directly with Granola as a privacy-focused alternative.

cards.title: Natura's $99 Smart Ring Runs AI Agents
cards.body: Natura's Interface smart ring lets users summon AI agents via finger press to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices. The device doubles as a health tracker starting at $99.

cards.title: OpenAI Revenue Falls Short of Projections
cards.body: Reports indicate OpenAI's annualized revenue is significantly lower than the previously reported $70 billion figure. The discrepancy raises questions about the AI lab's financial trajectory.

cards.title: Fired OpenAI Safety Researchers Dispute Claims
cards.body: Three dismissed OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct allegations in an open letter. They warn that their terminations create a chilling effect on the company's AI safety culture.

cards.title: Goodfire Launches Cost-Effective AI Agent Monitor
cards.body: Goodfire introduced an 'inside-out' monitoring system that observes AI agent behavior during execution at lower cost than traditional oversight methods. The technology only escalates to secondary AI review when suspicious activity is detected.

cards.title: 19-Year-Old Launches Personal AI Agent Startup
cards.body: Zach Yadegari, co-founder of Cal AI calorie tracking app, has raised $10 million for his new personal AI agent startup. The venture competes with established players like Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

cards.title: AI Models' Refusal Problem Explained
cards.body: Current AI systems are trained to refuse numerous prompts, but we may be overestimating their ability to say no. This limitation raises questions about AI safety and reliability in real-world applications.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic sequences for microscopic viruses in 2025. This breakthrough hints at AI's potential to design entirely new life forms.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Hype Outpaces Reality
cards.body: Recent AI breakthroughs in robotics are generating excitement, but practical applications remain limited. Don't expect humanoid robots to transform your daily life anytime soon.

cards.title: Industrial AI Enters Complex Automation Era
cards.body: Foundation models and agentic AI are enabling automation of sophisticated industrial tasks. Building safe systems for this transition is critical for widespread adoption.

cards.title: Nvidia Bets Big on Physical AI
cards.body: Nvidia is investing heavily in physical AI technology for robotaxis and humanoid robots. The approach aims to make autonomous systems safer and more practical.

cards.title: Microsoft Unveils AI-Focused Hardware
cards.body: Microsoft's recent event showcased new hardware designed specifically for AI workloads. Windows updates also reflect growing integration of AI capabilities into the OS.

cards.title: Developer Challenges Adobe With AI
cards.body: A bold open-source developer is creating AI-powered alternatives to Adobe's software suite. The move signals disruption in creative software markets through generative AI.
